title: Giga-Kohn-type results for the fully fractional heat equation
summary: We consider the semilinear fully fractional heat equation \[ (\partial_t-Δ)^σu = |u|^{p-1}u \quad \text{in } \mathbb{R}^n \times \mathbb{R}_{-}, \qquad 0 < σ< 1. \] For $n\leq 2σ$ or $1<p\leq \frac{n+2σ}{n-2σ}$, we generalize the monotonicity formula and Liouville-type theorem when $σ=1$ proved by Giga and Kohn. In order to overcome the difficulty that this equation is nonlocal, we give a new interpretation of the classical Giga-Kohn's Pohozaev identity in terms of Hermite expansion.
